_comment: The fields the server binds on, taken from its C# ingestion models and the
consumption CSV header written by ResourceInventory.ps1.
Deliberately narrow: it pins only the identity and join-key fields that keep
inventory, metrics, and consumption linkable. Descriptive fields (SKU, tier,
state) are not pinned - many are not server-bound yet and are free to change.
If a key here drifts, the server silently drops the value and the files stop
joining, which is what the gate exists to prevent.
Data only, no logic. Tests/SchemaContract.Tests.ps1 reads identityFields, the
serverBoundInventorySections names, the metrics block, and
consumption.requiredColumns, and checks a generated zip against them. The
top-level joinKeys block, consumption.joinKey, and each section's
serverModelKey / oneRowPerResource are documentation for the server-side owner
and are not read by the test.
Changing a key here changes the server contract, so it needs human approval
